witness_description: No certified witness: the quote supplies |M - x_n| < 1/n directly but gives no definition of f or relation between f(x_n) and x_n.
refutation_explanation: The bounded sweep finds formal numeric assignments where M - 1/n < y <= M while |M - x| >= 1/n if y is treated independently, but y cannot be certified as f(x_n) for the unspecified constructed objects without inventing missing definitions. Thus the alleged implication is unsupported by the permitted data, but a contextual counterexample is not decidable.
search_space: Exhaustively swept 750 tuples (n, M, x, y) with n in {1, ..., 6} and M, x, y in {-2, -1, 0, 1, 2}, using y only as a placeholder for f(x_n), in lexicographic order; this is illustrative, not exhaustive over unspecified functions or sequences.
